name: Fictional Story
source: Ida is a kind girl, but she has anger issues, and her boyfriend is exacerbating those issues by caring too much about his online activity, Tic Toc and NFTs. What better way is there for her to release some pent-up steam than to jump into bed with their old and ugly neighbour..?
